apps.localizedDescription: Run Symbian apps — the phone's own Calculator, Gallery and Notes, games, and anything you install from .sis / .sisx — inside an emulated Nokia, on an iPhone-style home screen. Includes the dynarmic JIT (enable JIT in SideStore or StikDebug for full speed). Firmware is not included: install your own phone's firmware (for example a Nokia N8 .vpl package) on first launch. Built on EKA2L1, licensed under the GNU GPL v3.

versions.localizedDescription:
SymbianBoard now runs on the Mac, and installs firmware straight from a downloaded zip.

**New**
- **Mac app** (Apple silicon, macOS 14+): `SymbianBoard-mac.dmg`. The same home screen and apps in a phone-shaped window, with the dynarmic JIT always on — no enabler needed.
- **Install firmware from a zip:** Install Device → Zip or 7z archive, then pick the firmware zip as you downloaded it (for example a Nokia N8 RM-596). Unzipped .vpl folders still work.
- **Music player works:** songs copied from your iPhone show up in the N8's Music player.
- New Symbian^3-style app icon.
- The N8 screen now stays above the Menu key strip in wide windows (iPad, Mac), so its softkeys are never covered.

**Install**
- iPhone: sideload `SymbianBoard.ipa` with AltStore, SideStore or Sideloadly, or add the source https://harkhowalia-1.github.io/SymbianBoard/altstore.json. Enable JIT with SideStore or StikDebug for full speed.
- Mac: open the DMG and drag SymbianBoard to Applications. It isn't notarized yet: on first launch open System Settings → Privacy & Security and click Open Anyway.

**Firmware is not included** — install your own phone's firmware on first launch.

**Known issues:** opening a single photo in Gallery crashes it; Clock quits on launch; not yet tested on real iPhone hardware; Intel Macs aren't supported.

First public build of SymbianBoard: Symbian apps on your iPhone, on an iOS-style home screen. Built on EKA2L1.

**What's in it**
- iPhone-style home screen with the apps' real Symbian icons, dock, folders, long-press actions and jiggle mode — or a Symbian^3-style Menu home screen
- The N8's silver Menu key under every running app; call keys in the calling apps
- Install .sis / .sisx apps with +; install Nokia firmware from a .vpl folder
- Apps keep running when you go home and resume instantly
- Your newest iPhone photos appear in the N8 Gallery; on-device songs are copied for the Music player
- Shortcuts: symbianboard:// links, the "Open Symbian App" Shortcuts action, Home Screen icons
- dynarmic JIT included — enable JIT with SideStore or StikDebug for full speed

**Install:** sideload SymbianBoard.ipa with AltStore, SideStore or Sideloadly, or add the source https://harkhowalia-1.github.io/SymbianBoard/altstore.json

**Firmware is not included** — install your own phone's firmware on first launch (Install Device → Nokia firmware (.vpl)).

**Known issues:** opening a single photo in Gallery crashes it; the Music player and Clock quit on launch; not yet tested on real iPhone hardware.
